Top Skills Ranking | Rank | PR (link) | Skill / Feature | Core Functionality | Recent Discussion Highlights | Current Status | |------|-----------|----------------|-------------------|------------------------------|----------------| | **1** | | **mcp‑builder fix** – support MCP ≥ 2 `streamable_http_client` import and custom headers | Updates the MCP builder to use the renamed `streamable_http_client` module (MCP ≥ 2) and enables custom HTTP headers via the new `create_mcp_http_client` / `http_client` APIs. | Community noted that the rename broke existing connections; the PR adds a migration shim and documents the new header configuration. | **OPEN** | | **2** | | **skill‑creator trigger‑eval isolation** | Refactors the eval viewer to run trigger evaluations in isolated subprocesses, fixes `select()`‑on‑Windows pipe issues, and adds robust handling of runtime failures. | Discussion emphasized the need for reliable trigger detection on Windows and the risk of false‑negative scores when unrelated tools interfere. | **OPEN** | | **3** | | **proofcore‑contract‑auditor** (new skill) | An Agent Skill that performs static analysis of Solidity & Rust smart contracts and publishes cryptographic audit proofs to the TON blockchain via ProofCore’s zero‑storage Merkle protocol. | Positive reception from Web3 developers; requests for additional language support (Vyper, Move) were raised. | **OPEN** | | **4** | | **Detect orphaned docx comments** | Adds logic to scan DOCX files for comment threads that have no associated paragraph, flagging them as “orphaned” for cleanup. | Users asked for a bulk‑report view and an automatic “remove orphan comments” command. | **OPEN** | | **5** | | **md2video‑audio** (new skill) | Converts Markdown documents into MP4 videos with realistic human‑like voiceovers, using Marp for slide generation and a TTS engine. | High interest from training‑material creators; questions about licensing of the underlying TTS model. | **OPEN** | | **6** | | **notion‑spec‑to‑implementation** & **quantitative‑resume‑auditor** (dual skill) | *Notion‑spec‑to‑implementation*: turns product/tech specs into concrete Notion tasks with acceptance criteria.
*Quantitative‑resume‑auditor*: evaluates resumes against quantitative benchmarks (e.g., impact metrics). | Strong demand for better spec‑to‑code pipelines; the resume‑auditor sparked debate on metric definitions. | **OPEN** | | **7** | | **skill‑creator eval‑viewer hardening** | Secures the local eval viewer (`generate_review.py` + `viewer.html`) against script breakout, DNS‑rebinding, cross‑site POST, and HTML‑escaping issues. | Security‑focused comments highlighted the need for sandboxing untrusted model output and using CSP headers. | **OPEN** | | **8** | | **docx timeout handling** | Makes the DOCX script return an explicit error when LibreOffice (`soffice`) times out and validates that the final DOCX contains no revision marks before reporting success. | Users reported silent “success” even when the conversion never completed; the fix was welcomed for clearer error reporting. | **OPEN** | *The ranking follows the order of PRs sorted by community comment activity (top‑20 PRs). All listed PRs are still **OPEN** (as of the snapshot date).* --- ### 2. Community Demand Trends (derived from Issues) | Trend | Evidence (Issue examples) | Implication for Future Skills | |-------|---------------------------|------------------------------| | **Secure, sandboxed skill execution** | #492 (trust‑boundary abuse), #1961 (eval‑viewer XSS), #1394 (escapeHtml not attribute‑safe) | Skills must isolate untrusted code, enforce strict CSP, and avoid `shell=True` in subprocesses. | | **Reliable trigger & evaluation pipelines** | #556 (run_eval.py never triggers skills), #1383 (benchmark layout bugs, Windows failures), #1352 (parallel workers cause false‑negative trigger rates) | Need robust, cross‑platform evaluation harnesses, better process isolation, and deterministic benchmarking. | | **Organization‑wide skill sharing** | #228 (request to share skills within an org) | A built‑in skill library or shareable links would reduce manual upload steps and encourage reuse. | | **Automation of documentation & quality control** | #189 (duplicate skills from `document-skills` & `example-skills`), #514 (typography quality), #83 (skill‑quality‑analyzer & skill‑security‑analyzer) | Tools that audit, standardise, or generate documentation (e.g., ODT, PDF, typographic checks) are highly requested. | | **Advanced testing & validation** | #822 (AI Watch Tester/AWT skill), #1385 (Reasoning Quality Gate Pipeline) | AI‑driven end‑to‑end testing and multi‑gate quality pipelines are seen as next‑level quality assurance. | | **Specialised domain adapters** | #1742 (MCP ≥ 2 support), #1703 (MD→Video/Audio), #1245 (Notion spec → tasks) | Community seeks skills that bridge Claude Code with other platforms (MCP, Web3, Notion, media creation). | **Overall demand:** *the community is most concentrated on improving the security, reliability, and usability of skill execution and evaluation pipelines, especially around trigger mechanisms, error handling, and cross‑platform compatibility.* --- ### 3. High‑Potential Pending Skills (active‑comment PRs not yet merged) | PR | Link | Brief Description | Why It’s High‑Potential | |----|------|-------------------|------------------------| | **#1961** | | Hardens the `skill‑creator` eval viewer against script breakout, DNS‑rebinding, cross‑site POST, and improper HTML escaping. | Addresses a critical security gap; likely to be merged quickly given the recent activity (Oct 3‑11). | | **#2004** | | Replaces `subprocess.Popen(..., shell=True)` with safer argument passing in `webapp-testing` scripts, mitigating command‑injection risk. | Directly tackles a known CWE‑78 vulnerability; community interest in secure scripting is high. | | **#1997** | | Fixes parsing of YAML front‑matter scalars (quote stripping, line‑continuation handling) so that description/metadata commands receive accurate values. | Improves data integrity for skill metadata; the bug is subtle but affects many downstream tools. | | **#1742** | | Enables MCP ≥ 2 `streamable_http_client` import and custom header configuration, fixing breakage from the MCP 2 rename. | Core infrastructure change; many downstream skills depend on reliable MCP handling. | | **#1298** | | Isolates trigger evaluations and adds Windows‑specific pipe handling, reducing false‑negative trigger rates. | Directly resolves the “run_eval.py never triggers skills” issue reported in #556, making it a priority. | *These PRs are still **OPEN**, have recent comments, and address pressing technical or security concerns, suggesting they may be merged in the near term.* --- ### 4. Skills Ecosystem Insight > **The community’s most concentrated demand is for more secure, reliable, and cross‑platform skill execution—particularly around trigger evaluation, error handling, and sandboxing—so that new domain‑specific skills (e.g., Web3, Notion, media creation) can be built on a stable foundation.** --- *All GitHub URLs are functional as of 2026‑10‑15.* --- # Claude Code Community Digest — 2026-10-15 --- ## 1. Today's Highlights Two patch releases (v2.1.299 → v2.1.300) landed in the last 24 hours, introducing **idle conversation compaction** (auto-compacts 200K+ token sessions after ~54 min of inactivity), a **`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FILE_MENTIONS`** env var to pass file paths instead of contents to the model, and **OpenTelemetry cache-token split** (5 min / 1 hr lifetimes). Meanwhile, the desktop app's 2.37337.1 update triggered a wave of UI regressions: the Routines sidebar section disappeared on macOS/Windows, Remote Control sessions drop on auto-update relaunch, and a permission-prompt default flipped to "Always allow." --- ## 2. Releases | Version | Key Changes | |---------|-------------| | **v2.1.300** | • `virtualText` support in prompt decorations (rendered text that never enters draft/submitted prompt)
• OpenTelemetry `api_request` event now emits `cache_creation_5m_tokens` & `cache_creation_1h_tokens` for granular cache-write tracking | | **v2.1.299** | • `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FILE_MENTIONS=1` — sends `@` file paths to model instead of file contents (reduces token spend)
• **Idle compaction**: conversations >200K tokens left idle ~54 min are auto-compacted before next interaction | [View releases on GitHub](https://github​.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases) --- ## 3. Hot Issues (Top 10 by Impact & Discussion) | # | Issue | Why It Matters | Community Signal | |---|-------|----------------|------------------| | [#28304](https://github​.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/28304) | **Claude Desktop 1.1.4173 crashes on startup (no window, process lingers)** | Blocks all Desktop users on affected build; 43 comments, 31 👍 | 🔥 **Critical** — widespread startup failure | | [#102158](https://github​.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/102158) | **Routines sidebar section hidden, no toggle — scheduled task results inaccessible** | Regression in 2.37337.1; breaks scheduled-task workflow | 4 comments, 5 👍 — macOS/Desktop | | [#100106](https://github​.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/100106) | **Auto-update relaunch drops all Remote Control sessions; no auto-reconnect** | Remote sessions go offline overnight; manual recovery required | 4 comments — macOS/Desktop | | [#102236](https://github​.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/102236) | **Background classification agents consume ~10% of 5h token quota/minute** | Runaway token burn in autonomous agent loops; cost surprise | 3 comments — cost/agents | | [#94032](https://github​.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/94032) | **`summarizedThinking` flag forces `--thinking-display summarized` on all models, no opt-out** | Full thinking chains inaccessible; flag overrides user preference | 3 comments — macOS/iOS/Desktop | | [#102134](https://github​.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/102134) | **`session.compact` mod hook no longer fires in 2.1.299 (manual & auto compaction)** | Breaks plugin/compaction integrations; regression from idle-compaction feature | 3 comments — hooks/plugins | | [#102136](https://github​.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/102136) | **Permission prompt defaults to "Always allow" instead of "Allow once" — dangerous UX regression** | Security risk: users inadvertently grant broad filesystem/network access | 2 comments, 2 👍 — permissions/Desktop | | [#95688](https://github​.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/95688) | **Gmail connector can't attach local files without base64 round-trip** | Forces reading file → base64 → tool call; no path/handle pass-through | 2 comments, 3 👍 — Windows/MCP/Desktop | | [#100568](https://github​.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/100568) | **Sandboxed Bash opens every `sandbox.credentials.files` path (4× each) on every command** | Floods audit logs, 170+ credential files → massive `open()` syscall storm | 1 comment — macOS/security/sandbox | | [#102245](https://github​.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/102245) | **Windows: idle Code session pins one thread at 100% CPU for hours** | Silent battery/thermal drain; no user-visible activity | 0 comments — Windows/Desktop/perf | --- ## 4. Key PR Progress | PR | Status | Summary | |----|--------|---------| | [#86870](https://github​.com/anthropics/claude-code/pull/86870) | **Closed** | Security-review hook: added session-context checks (CVS status, educational labs) before triggering CVP status changes; prevents false positives during authorized security research | | [#85834](https://github​.com/anthropics/claude-code/pull/85834) | **Closed** | DevContainer fix for `hookify` plugin install — enables HackerOne Bug Bounty Program access in codespaces | > Only 2 PRs updated in the last 24h; both are security/infrastructure fixes merged weeks ago. --- ## 5. Feature Request Trends (from all 50 issues) | Theme | Representative Issues | Frequency | |-------|----------------------|-----------| | **Desktop UI/UX polish** | Restore Routines sidebar (#102158, #102247), hide Environment panel in split view (#102233), show last-activity in ⌘K Recents (#102246), Run-history side panel for Scheduled Tasks (#100563) | 6+ issues | | **Remote Control reliability** | Push notifications while terminal focused (#93997), auto-reconnect after app update (#100106), configurable cross-session send pause (#100233) | 3 issues | | **Token/cost observability & control** | Suppress "task tools unused" reminder (#64192), background agent token burn (#102236), "Reset for free" auto-apply on downgrade (#98664) | 3 issues | | **Sandbox/credentials ergonomics** | Credential-file open storm (#100568), NFS inode >2^63 support (#102217), seeded plugins auto-load without `/reload-plugins` (#102240) | 3 issues | | **Keybinding/configurability** | Flip Enter/Shift+Enter send behavior (#101352), worktree default OFF for task chips (#102221) | 2 issues | | **Connector/file-handling gaps** | Gmail connector local-file attach without base64 (#95688) | 1 issue | --- ## 6. Developer Pain Points (Recurring Frustrations) 1. **Desktop regressions per update** — Routines sidebar vanishing, Remote Control sessions dying on auto-update, new unhideable panels consuming split-view width. Users feel "every update breaks my workflow." 2. **Permission UX regression** — Defaulting to "Always allow" is seen as a security anti-pattern; no granular "Allow once" / "Allow for session" memory. 3. **Token surprises** — Background agents silently consuming quota, "Reset for free" applying unexpectedly on plan downgrade, no suppression knob for repetitive system reminders. 4. **Sandbox friction** — Credential-file `open()` storm on every Bash call; NFS inode limitations blocking research workloads; plugins requiring manual reload per session. 5. **Mobile/Remote gaps** — Android input focus loss with physical keyboard, no push notifications while terminal focused, no auto-reconnect after host restart. 6. **Thinking-display opacity** — Feature flag forces summarized thinking with no user override; full chains inaccessible even when needed for debugging. --- *Digest generated from `anthropics/claude-code` GitHub data (releases, issues, PRs updated 2026-10-14 → 2026-10-15).*

Feature Request Trends From the open issues, the most‑recurring feature directions are: 1. **Session & State Management** - Cross‑app session sync (CLI ↔ Desktop) – #4082 - Persistent session names & better UI for session list – #5132, #5135 - Automatic session compaction / idle timeout aligned to model prompt‑cache TTL – #4724 2. **Permission & Sandbox UX** - Reduce permission‑request noise for local operations – #5146, #5144 - Sandbox path grants honoured by JVM processes – #5105, #4516 - Subagent permission inheritance – #5144 3. **Model & Provider Flexibility** - Prompt caching for Claude/Gemini – #3808 - BYOK provider sampling configuration (avoid forced temperature = 0) – #4950 - Support for newer models (Gemini 4 Argon already added) 4. **Keyboard & Interaction Ergonomics** - Expand/copy/thoughts shortcuts (Ctrl+E/Y) – already delivered in v1.0.98‑2 - Default agent selection without interactive picker – #5141 - Prevent Copilot from stealing focus while user types – #5131 5. **Observability & Diagnostics** - Timestamps in conversation view – #2535 (closed, but still referenced) - Improved feedback flow labeling – #4848 - Exportable diagnostic bundles for troubleshooting --- ### 6.
